control_name: Privileged accounts are protected by MFA
business_impact: A compromised privileged identity can change tenant-wide settings and access sensitive organizational resources.
recommendation: Require phishing-resistant MFA for administrative roles through Conditional Access and maintain emergency-access procedures.
licensing_note: Conditional Access normally requires Microsoft Entra ID P1 or an eligible Microsoft 365 licence.

control_name: Enabled users are registered for MFA
business_impact: Password-only accounts are more exposed to phishing, credential stuffing and password reuse.
recommendation: Register every enabled user for an approved MFA method and enforce MFA using an appropriate tenant policy.

business_impact: Too many Global Administrators expand the privileged attack surface; too few can create resilience and recovery risk.
recommendation: Maintain a small, justified set of Global Administrators and use lower-privilege roles for routine administration.
source_name: Best practices for Microsoft Entra roles

control_name: Enabled member accounts are recently active
business_impact: Unneeded enabled accounts retain licences, permissions and access paths after legitimate use has ended.
recommendation: Validate ownership and business need, then disable accounts no longer required through the approved offboarding process.

business_impact: External identities may retain access after a supplier, project or collaboration has ended.
recommendation: Review stale guests with their sponsor and block or remove access where continued business need cannot be confirmed.
source_name: Monitor and clean up stale guest accounts

control_name: Recurring guest access reviews are configured
pass_message: Recurring guest access reviews are enabled.
fail_message: Recurring guest access reviews are not configured.
business_impact: Without periodic recertification, external access can accumulate and become difficult to govern.
recommendation: Introduce recurring access reviews for guest access to Microsoft 365 groups and business applications.
source_name: Manage guest access with access reviews
licensing_note: Access Reviews may require Microsoft Entra ID Governance or eligible premium licensing.

fail_message: No enabled Conditional Access policy is recorded.
business_impact: Static authentication controls cannot respond effectively to user, device, location and risk signals.
recommendation: Plan and deploy baseline Conditional Access policies using report-only testing and emergency-access exclusions.
licensing_note: Conditional Access normally requires Microsoft Entra ID P1 or an eligible Microsoft 365 licence.

fail_message: Legacy authentication is not recorded as blocked.
business_impact: Legacy protocols may not support modern authentication protections and can increase account-compromise risk.
recommendation: Identify dependencies, migrate affected clients and block legacy authentication through Conditional Access.

business_impact: Missing audit evidence reduces accountability and limits investigation of user and administrator activity.
recommendation: Verify audit availability, search permissions and retention against investigation and compliance needs.

control_name: Sign-in and audit activity is reviewed centrally
pass_message: A centralized sign-in and audit review process is recorded.
fail_message: No centralized sign-in and audit review process is recorded.
business_impact: Important changes and unusual authentication activity may not be reviewed consistently.
recommendation: Assign review ownership, define a regular review cadence and document escalation criteria appropriate to the SME.

control_name: Automatic external mailbox forwarding is controlled
business_impact: Automatic forwarding can send business email and sensitive information outside organizational control.
recommendation: Confirm business justification, remove unauthorized forwarding and enforce an outbound forwarding policy with documented exceptions.

pass_message: A risky sign-in response policy is enabled.
fail_message: No risky sign-in response policy is recorded.
business_impact: Risk indicators may be visible but not consistently challenged, blocked or reviewed.
recommendation: Define a proportionate response for risky sign-ins, including MFA challenge, access blocking and administrator review.
licensing_note: Automated risk policies and detailed risk features may require Microsoft Entra ID P2.

business_impact: Unresolved risk signals can indicate compromised credentials, unexpected access or a legitimate event requiring explanation.
recommendation: Review affected identities and sign-in context, confirm legitimacy and record the outcome before closing the item.
source_name: Investigate risk with Microsoft Entra ID Protection
